arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/home')
import parse

# Test findall with case_sensitive on actual text
text = 'Hello HELLO hello'

# Case sensitive pattern should match only exact case
p1 = parse.Parser(r'(hello)', case_sensitive=True)
r1 = list(p1.findall(text))
print(f'case_sensitive=True: {len(r1)} results')

# Case insensitive should match all
p2 = parse.Parser(r'(hello)', case_sensitive=False)
r2 = list(p2.findall(text))
print(f'case_sensitive=False: {len(r2)} results')
" 2>&1
